subject: Security tooling RFP: coverage gaps & implementation runway
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security tooling RFP: coverage gaps & implementation runway

Team —

Quick summary: procurement asked us to pick a single compliance platform for SOC2/ISO evidence collection and automation. We ran a light PoC with TrustCenter and Drata last quarter and need to choose an onboarding approach that aligns to our Q3 roadmap (KMS, SSO, log retention, evidence timelines).

Attached: coverage-matrix.xlsx (vendor-to-control mapping), sow-draft-v1.pdf (implementation SOW stub).

Questions for this thread:
- Which vendor covers our SAML + Okta provisioning requirements out of the box?
- Which vendor can sign the KMS/HSM requirements (we need BYOK or HSM-backed key management for keys in logs pipeline)?
- Proposed rollout: vendor kickoff -> 4-week ingestion pilot -> parallel evidence collection for 2 months -> full cutover. Is that runway feasible given procurement timelines?

Action items:
1) Dev — confirm SSO + logfile ingestion effort (what connectors we need, approx eng hours).
2) Laura — procurement needs estimated seat pricing and preferred contract length (12 vs 36 months) to model cost.
3) Vanessa — security acceptance criteria and any non-negotiable vendor obligations (e.g., data residency, audit log retention).

I’ve pulled the coverage matrix into Drive (link below). If we can all agree on the main unknowns by next Tuesday (Apr 13) I’ll schedule vendor kickoff meetings for the week of Apr 20.

Thanks,

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com

Attachments: coverage-matrix.xlsx, sow-draft-v1.pdf
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security tooling RFP: coverage gaps & implementation runway

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear matrix. Quick technical notes:
- TrustCenter has a native Okta integration for SCIM and SAML; Drata supports Okta too but requires a small custom connector for our on-prem log forwarder.
- KMS: Drata is comfortable with BYOK via customer-managed keys (AWS KMS), TrustCenter currently offers an HSM-backed managed key option but their legal team needs to confirm the export controls language.
- Log ingestion: the main work is the on-prem aggregator to forward structured logs to the vendor; estimate ~2-3 sprints (4-6 ppl-weeks) to build, test, and secure the pipeline if we parallelize with their ingestion team.

Open flag: if procurement expects the vendor to host log artifacts outside our VPC, we need explicit contract clauses for retention, encryption, and deletion windows.

I can scope a detailed implementation estimate by Wed (Apr 14).

—Dev
Dev Patel
Engineering Manager, Platform
dev_patel@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security tooling RFP: coverage gaps & implementation runway

Priyom / team —

Procurement perspective: budget for a baseline SOC2/ISO package (ingestion + 10 seats + audit assistance) is expected to be in the $85k–$120k range for 12 months depending on addons. 36-month pricing gives ~18% discount typically. We need the vendor to accept our Master Services Agreement redlines on data handling and audit cooperation.

For timeline:
- Legal review of vendor T&Cs: 7–10 business days once vendor sends final terms.
- SOW negotiation and signatures (DocuSign): 3–7 business days after redlines are exchanged.
- Procurement paperwork and POs: 5 business days after countersignature.

If we aim for vendor kickoff the week of Apr 20, please ask the vendors to provide draft T&Cs and a rough SOW by EOD Apr 14 so legal can start parallel review.

I’ll draft a single-page procurement memo (cost, recommended vendor, implementation risk) once Dev confirms the implementation estimate.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: procurement-memo-template.docx (stub referenced in Drive)
From: Jenna Park <jenna@trustcenter.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@dratainc.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security tooling RFP: coverage gaps & implementation runway

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the notes and the coverage matrix — appreciate the level of detail. A few quick items from TrustCenter: 
- We can provide HSM-backed key management for audit logs; I’ve attached our KMS statement of work (SOW-KMS.pdf) and a standard data processing addendum.
- For Okta SCIM/SAML we support provisioning and can assign a technical onboarding engineer for the ingestion pilot.
- Next steps: I’ll upload draft T&Cs and a sample SOW link by EOD Apr 14; happy to schedule a 30-minute kickoff with our onboarding lead on Apr 21.

Also: we saw the log examples in the coverage matrix — to speed ingestion we recommend starting with the authn/authz and audit logs first, then expand to infra logs in phase 2.

If you want, I can also connect your legal and vendor teams (cc’d Miguel from Drata here) to start a redline exchange.

Best,

Jenna Park
Enterprise Sales, TrustCenter
jenna@trustcenter.com

Attachment: SOW-KMS.pdf
